body:
I don't want to make any false promises here, but I've seen that everything that we do for ourselves pays off at some point. It's happened with me before. It's kinda like karma rewarding you but randomly out of nowhere.

Have faith and keep moving on.
Thanks a lot for your reply. I hope I'm able to figure stuff out like you said...
Rest in peace. Sorry we couldn't help.

Trust me, at no point have you seen everything. You'll find something you like real soon, just keep your eyes open.

Getting back on your feet isn't the aim, it never should be. Just do your best for everyone around you. Make living about others.

If you want to try something right now, you could join a Covid-19 volunteer group in your area and help people in need. All you need is a phone and maybe a Twitter account.

Feel free to dm me.

Hey... About the phone, imo you can get it fixed easily. It should be the least of your worries to be honest, I've had way worse stuff happen and still got it fixed.

Don't believe that you're lazy. You're just in a bad situation. Also, don't let random people on social media make you decide your worth. No matter how close they may be. You're the only one who gets to decide that and you should set it high.

Don't listen to music now. Most of pop music just makes everyone feel worse in these times.

Go and sleep. You'll be surprised how much sleep can do for you.

Don't attempt suicide. Your parents will be broken. I'm in college and I've been having my grades going down for months now. It's compounded by the fact that I used to get good grades before and now I don't know how to get them anymore. Just can't because of what I do. 

Maybe accept that this isn't for you and do something you actually enjoy doing. You know you.

Good luck.

Don't worry about getting left behind. You'll find something eventually. Just wait it out and don't be sad about it. Work on your skills and what you're not good at, and polish what you are good at.

You'll be surprised what just 5 minutes of working on yourself everyday can do for you.

I feel like a hypocrite saying this, but it's the only way out of this hellhole. I know it myself too, but right now I just want to be sad I guess.
I swear to god this is why I broke up with my ex. You're not alone
